performance.verdict: Attribution gap masks real volume; 11 overdue milestones block any scale decision.

findings.text: Windsor shows 30 leads / CPL $43.77 while GHL shows 569 opportunities created and 87 won — a 19:1 gap confirms attribution_gap flag, not demand collapse.
11 SOW milestones overdue by 1–4 months: intake owner unconfirmed (Aug-31), booking bot untested (Jul-31), heating campaigns not live (Oct-01), budget scale-up blocked (Oct-31), and 7 others.
3-day lead signal (Oct-30/31/Nov-01): 0 leads across 3 days vs 3 leads/day average in the Oct-16–25 window — confirmed drought, not noise.
GBP actions spiked +393.75% (7d delta) and organic search clicks +122% — organic demand accelerating while paid leads zero out, widening the attribution gap.
Top campaign BWS-Heating-Search-Calls consumed $735.28 of $814.48 Google spend (90%) with only 7 recorded conversions — likely pixel-side zero-read, not campaign failure.

suggestions.text: Reconcile Windsor vs GHL: map all 569 GHL opps to paid source tags to establish true CPL before any budget move.
suggestions.monday_update: Windsor reports 30 leads at $43.77 CPL while GHL shows 569 opportunities created and 87 won — these are unreconciled. Pull GHL source attribution for all opps created in the last 28 days and match against Meta and Google campaign UTMs. Success check: a single reconciled lead count with source breakdown is in hand by 2026-11-06. Until this is resolved, no budget changes can be defended.

suggestions.text: Confirm intake owner with active GHL login; 3-day lead drought and speed-to-lead automations pointing at an empty seat since Jul-07.
suggestions.monday_update: Vivian left dispatch on 7/7 and the intake owner seat has been unconfirmed since the Aug-31 milestone. The last 3 days show 0 leads while GBP organic actions surged — inbound demand may be arriving but not being captured in the CRM. Confirm who owns intake, verify their GHL login is active, and confirm after-hours coverage is routed correctly. Success check: named intake owner with verified GHL login confirmed to Nacer and Sohib by 2026-11-07.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta lead volume for 3 more days; do not adjust budgets until attribution reconciliation (S1) is complete by Nov-06.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta leads dropped 71.43% week-over-week but the Windsor–GHL gap makes it impossible to confirm whether this is a real demand drop or a tracking failure. Google's 7 conversions on $814.48 spend also carries a known pixel-read issue. Hold all budget changes until the attribution fix (S1) produces a reconciled lead count. Re-check on 2026-11-06 — if reconciled Meta CPL is still above the Oct-16–25 baseline of roughly $17/lead (30 leads / ~$498 spend), escalate to a creative_refresh.
